note: Approved village map 21 Nov 2026. World coords metres: x east, z south. place.front = TRUE front unit vector (already corrected; game front = +z local). Existing places keep their 3D model: only position/rotation change. kind new_* = to be built. Existing places also carry "before" (their position and TRUE front in the running game on 9 Nov, read from the game), so each move = rotate by angle(before.front -> front) about the place, then translate before -> new. Source of truth for the map: artifact "Amrai Kheda map: proposed changes". | 25 Nov 2026 final map (viewer v7): shops and houses parallel to roads, nothing on roads, Sabzi row of shops, wedding hall on highway with lights shop, Farmers coop moved, parking behind hall, railway on west side with station behind masjid.
